insights.title: ₹9.8L Free-Rider Waste in Snacks & Grocery
insights.description: Two campaigns in Grocery & Staples are bleeding ₹6L weekly (Eid Essentials: 58% free-rider ratio, Oil BOGO: 57%). Weekend Snack Bundle has 62% free-riders with 1.4× ROI vs. target 3.5×.
insights.action: Immediately gate Eid Essentials to new/lapsed buyers and convert Oil BOGO to bundle mechanic. Pause Weekend Snack Bundle until redesigned with eligibility controls.

insights.title: Loyalty Gold Cashback Delivers 3.7× ROI
insights.description: Personal Care cashback campaign generated ₹21.1L incremental revenue on ₹5.7L spend with only 31% free-riders and 28% lift. Best-in-class mechanic with 88% confidence.
insights.action: Replicate Loyalty Gold cashback model to Grocery & Staples and Snacks categories. Allocate ₹5L from underperforming bundle budgets to scale this mechanic.

insights.title: ₹6.2L Cost Passthrough Gap Eroding Margins
insights.description: India Gate Basmati 5kg cost increased 8% but shelf price unchanged—margin dropped to 12.0%. ₹6.2L total cost passthrough gaps across portfolio with margin realization down 1.4% to 79.47%.
insights.action: Execute immediate ₹30 price increase on India Gate Basmati. Run cost-change audit on all Grocery & Staples SKUs and implement weekly automated cost-to-shelf alerts.

insights.title: ₹4.0L Markdown Risk with 69.8% Sell-Through
insights.description: Sell-through rate 5.17 points below target at 69.83%, exposing ₹39.9L inventory to markdown risk. ₹3.4L already lost to premature markdowns this week.
insights.action: Accelerate slow-movers in Snacks & Biscuits with targeted 10-15% flash promos to loyalty segments only. Hold markdown decisions 72 hours while testing velocity pricing on top 20 at-risk SKUs.
